title: CaptureBundle
description: Device-agnostic property capture envelope for RE acquisition CRM. Records voice memo + property photos against a deal/parcel. Primary match key: property address (APN secondary). workspaceId/ownerId are server-derived.

captureId.description: Client-generated UUID (v4/v7). THE idempotency key: maps to Note.id and seeds deterministic Attachment ids. The server records (workspaceId, captureId) in an atomic claim row BEFORE any Twenty write, so a parallel or replayed bundle with the same captureId is serialized and upserts, never duplicates.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version so server can evolve the shape.

repId.description: workspaceMemberId of the capturing rep (display/cross-check ONLY). Authoritative owner is server-derived from the verified JWT. A repId that disagrees with the token is IGNORED for ownership and LOGGED as a possible spoof signal - the bundle is NOT rejected solely on this mismatch.

capturedAt.description: Client wall-clock at capture, ISO-8601 WITH offset (e.g. 2026-06-09T14:32:00-05:00). Server stores receivedAt independently and NEVER overwrites capturedAt.

timezone.description: IANA tz id (e.g. America/Chicago). Kept separate from the offset for DST-correct display.

deviceClockUncertaintyMs.description: Known clock drift bound for the offline device, if measurable. Nullable.

clientSeq.description: Per-device monotonic Lamport sequence for intra-device ordering. Nullable on first/legacy clients.

deviceType.description: The ONLY field that changes per capture device. Keeps the contract glasses-ready with zero other changes.

deviceModel.description: e.g. iPhone 15 Pro, RealWear Navigator 520. Nullable.

batteryLow.description: true if <20% at capture - signals possible truncated media; server cross-checks media sha256 on such captures. Nullable.

geo.description: Device-level GPS fix fallback (per-photo EXIF is separate). SENSITIVE PII (homeowner location): subject to retention TTL + erasure path. Nullable when location denied / glasses have no GPS.

captureOrigin.description: Capture type. DRIVE_BY/SITE_WALK select inspection type downstream. Nullable.

target.description: Record resolution input. Either an explicit id (rep had a lead open) OR matchHints (door-knock, no lead yet). Server verifies any explicit id (a) exists, (b) is in the caller workspace, and (c) the caller has record-level UPDATE permission on it - else 404 (cross-workspace/absent) or 403 FORBIDDEN_RECORD (in-workspace but not authorized). matchConfidence/matchedRecordId are computed SERVER-SIDE and never accepted here.

propertyId.description: Explicit Property id (wins if present, after authorization). Nullable.

opportunityId.description: Explicit Opportunity id (wins if present, after workspace + record-level authorization). Nullable.

matchHints.description: Door-knock fallback matching signals when no explicit id. All strings length-capped to bound matcher cost and abuse. Nullable.

audio.description: Exactly one voice memo per capture. References phase-1 fileId OR a pendingMediaId not yet uploaded. Exactly one of fileId/pendingMediaId must be non-null (enforced by oneOf below). sha256 is REQUIRED - it is the truncation/integrity guard verified server-side against the stored blob.

fileId.description: Server fileId (v4 UUID) returned by phase-1 uploadFilesFieldFile. Null until uploaded; never client-synthesized. pendingMediaId then required.

pendingMediaId.description: Client UUID for an as-yet-unuploaded audio object; becomes the per-media idempotency key on pre-upload. Exactly one of fileId/pendingMediaId must be non-null.

filename.description: Must end .m4a or .wav - drives server ext/MIME detection. Nullable only when fileId already resolved upstream.

sampleRateHz.description: 16000 recommended for voice STT. Server may 422 if > 24000 for a voice memo (oversize guardrail). Nullable.

durationSec.description: Hard cap 30 min. Server may reject longer as UNPROCESSABLE.

audioChannel.description: Maps to downstream documentMeta.audioChannel; can't be cheaply re-derived server-side. Recommend MONO for voice.

bitrateKbps.description: Server may 422 if > 64 for a voice memo (cellular oversize guardrail). Nullable.

sizeBytes.description: <= server maxFileSize (10MB default). Cellular soft-cap ~2-3MB recommended. Nullable.

sha256.description: REQUIRED. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the full audio bytes. Server verifies the stored blob hash matches; mismatch -> reject (truncation/swapped-bytes guard).

fileId.description: Server fileId (v4 UUID) from phase-1. Null until uploaded; never client-synthesized.

pendingMediaId.description: Client UUID for unuploaded photo (per-media idempotency key). Exactly one of fileId/pendingMediaId non-null.

filename.description: Drives ext/MIME detection. Nullable when fileId resolved.

mimeType.description: Declared MIME; server re-sniffs magic bytes, asserts sniffed value is in THIS exact narrow enum (image/svg+xml explicitly excluded), transcodes/strips trailing bytes to defeat polyglots, and stores the SNIFFED value.

sequenceIndex.description: Photo 1..N ordering; seeds deterministic Attachment id uuidv5(captureId,'photo:'+sequenceIndex). Nullable.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of full bytes. Strongly recommended; server verifies when present.

caption.description: e.g. north slope, hail strike closeup. Becomes Attachment file[0].label (Attachment.name is deprecated).

tags.description: Controlled vocab for RE property photos. Nullable.

exif.description: EXIF-derived metadata. GPS is SENSITIVE PII (homeowner house): server may strip on ingest per workspace policy. GPS often absent - nullable; geo fallback is at bundle level.

dispositionUpdate.description: Optional Opportunity stage advance. Server parks (202) until the capture's Note exists (causality: capture lands before disposition). Applied AT MOST ONCE per captureId (dispositionApplied flag on the idempotency row) and guarded by If-Match so a human who moved the stage is not silently overwritten. Nullable.

dealStage.description: Twenty Opportunity.dealStage SELECT options (RE Acquisition app).

dependsOn.description: captureIds that must be DONE first. Nullable; defaults to [this.captureId].

clientNotes.description: Optional rep free-text appended to the Note placeholder body before the voice pipeline fills structured fields. Nullable.
